column6: Audio stops dead at the end of every episode, and the setting that would fix it is off, jargon-named, and only works from one screen
After the app launches, the car's play button is dead — metadata is sent to the head unit but no action handlers are installed
A "stop" press on the head unit tears the whole player down and unregisters every control, leaving the car with no transport at all
An episode that fails to play says nothing, anywhere — the tap is simply swallowed
A network stall is completely silent: no spinner, no message, and the button keeps saying Pause with no sound coming out
The steering-wheel next/previous buttons are permanently dead for ordinary episodes, even with a full Up Next list
A part-played Foray cannot be resumed from the mini bar — and the bar may show a stale single episode instead
The Foray scrubber is a 12px-high strip where any stray tap instantly jumps you minutes through the hour
Stop and "Close" are identical ~30px pills side by side, and only one of them keeps your place
The mini bar has exactly one control, so every other transport action costs two deliberate taps
Up Next rows pack five targets including 22px-tall reorder arrows immediately beside a destructive remove
Start over wipes your place in an hour-long programme from behind an 11px underlined text link
The app talks to me in its own production vocabulary — "segments", "beats", "part 12 of 32"
The only Foray a newcomer can actually play has no narration in it, so it does not do what onboarding just promised
Tapping ▶ paints the button as "playing" before any audio exists, and a failed play says nothing at all
The row's play button turns into a pause glyph, and pressing it does not pause
A brand-new user's first Home screen can be missing the Forays row entirely — and the code says so
Nothing in the app explains what a Foray is once the one-time sheet is gone
Touching the search box empties the screen and throws away my scroll position
Two navigation systems, different names for the same pages, and Forays is on neither tab
The "Episodes for you" section contains no episodes
A failed episode load tells me to pull to refresh, and there is no pull to refresh
The returning-user intro popup describes a Home screen that no longer exists
A Foray title ships the internal word "beats" to the listener
The Library's empty state sends me to a screen that has no playlist builder
The Create tab ships a permanently dead "Foray" button, and its suggestion chips don't create anything
Reordering Up Next rebuilds the whole list, so the row moves out from under my thumb
A search can lock the page for seconds and then grow a new section, with nothing on screen saying to wait
Anything I queue from a show page or search shows up in Up Next as "Episode no longer available"
Up Next never plays through: auto-advance is off by default, buried in a drawer, and then still refuses most episodes
Following a show has no consequence anywhere in the app
My followed shows are not in Library — they are hidden behind the Search tab
One star glyph, three meanings, and none of them is "follow"
Open in: Apple Podcasts is one of only three settings I can see, and it controls nothing
The ↻ button in the header throws me back to Home from whatever I was reading
The same page is called "Shows" in the menu, "Search" in the tab bar, and its search box claims to search only shows
Nothing in the app I can go back and read tells me what a Foray is
A primary tab named "Create" greets me with a disabled button and an apology
There is no way to put a specific episode into a playlist
Episode rows leave about 114px for the title at phone width
On my first day Home tells me a pick is "Outside your usual subjects" — I have no usual subjects
A Foray title I can actually reach is written in internal vocabulary: "eight beats of a forty-beat history"
First launch is a blank screen behind a header — ~3.5 MB of JSON with no spinner, no skeleton, no text
There is not one play button anywhere on the first-run Home screen
The only explanation of what a Foray is lives behind one dismissable sheet, and the left-hand button destroys it forever
Sixty seconds after install the app tells me what my "usual subjects" are
Continuous playback — the thing the founder explicitly wants for the car — is off by default, buried in the drawer, and never fires for anything I played from Home or a show page
The settings menu shows me the founder's debug switches: "Show draft Forays", "Voice engine probe", "Playback diagnostics"
Open in: Apple Podcasts is a setting that does literally nothing — its only consumer is dead code
The Library tab does not contain Forays or Starred Shows, even though the tab bar routes #/forays to Library
An empty state tells me to do something on a screen that has no such control
Create is one of four primary tabs, and half of what it offers is permanently switched off
The tab labelled "Search" opens a page headed "Shows" with 220 alphabetical rows and the search field pinned at the bottom
The ↻ button reads as "reload" and actually teleports me to Home from whatever page I was on
Forays for you is a section of one, and it is a startup-finance programme regardless of what I picked in onboarding
Episodes for you contains no episodes — the cards are subject queues named after topics
Continuous playback is OFF by default and only works if you started from Up Next — so in the car, one episode ends and the app goes silent
Inside a Foray the 15/30-second skip buttons silently turn into previous/next-clip, and there is no way left to nudge back a few seconds
Three developer tools ship in every listener's Settings drawer: "Show draft Forays", "Voice engine probe", "Playback diagnostics"
Back to the running order — broadcast-industry jargon on a visible button in the expanded player
One thing has five names in user-visible copy: segment, clip, piece, part, beat
Internal error strings with file paths are printed to the listener: "Can't play: segment X is not in data/segments.json"
Forays — the app's whole differentiator — are not a tab, and the drawer and tab bar give the same pages two different names
The progress strip's accessible name — which is read aloud — is four pieces of jargon and two counts that contradict each other
The narrator says "this act", "Act one", "two acts back" out loud — a word the app never defines and never shows
A Foray's title is "Barbecue: eight beats of a forty-beat history" — "beat" is the codebase's private word for a clip
STRETCH in bold uppercase is the app's internal word for an exploration pick, and its explanation is the quietest line on the card
The Interests page prints raw taxonomy ids ("engineering/energy-fusion") under every slider, and the reset button says "Reset to learned"
The voice picker says "Audition", "trial voices" and "Greyed voices are free downloads — fetch one in Settings"
Playback diagnostics — a drawer item every user can open — describes itself with "seam gaps", "out-point overshoot" and "load deadlines"
There is no Download button anywhere — offline listening does not exist
Starring a show is inert — new episodes of shows I follow appear nowhere
When an episode ends, playback just stops — continuous play is off by default and only works inside Up Next
The "Search" tab does not open a search — it opens an A–Z list of 220 shows with the field at the bottom
The show-page error state tells me to use a gesture the app does not have
Two navigation systems that name the same places differently
Create is a primary tab, and half of its only control is permanently dead
Nothing on any list tells me which episodes I already played, or how far in I am
The now-playing bar: tapping the artwork does nothing, there is no skip, and Stop sits next to Close
The Settings menu is full of developer switches
Open in: Apple Podcasts / Pocket Casts is a setting that changes nothing
Episodes for you contains no episodes
Forays — the whole point of the app — are unexplained after one dismissible sheet, and there is only one to play
Producer jargon in listener-facing copy: "segments", "beats", "the download counts"
